payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about various baseline models used in speech translation experiments, including their configurations and training methods.

claims.text: The baselines include a vanilla speech translation (ST) model, pre-training baselines (encoder, decoder, and encoder-decoder pre-training), and multi-task baselines (one-to-many, many-to-one, many-to-many).
Cascaded systems combining ASR and MT models are also considered as baselines, with variations like re-segmenting ASR outputs before feeding them to the MT system.
Experiments were conducted on the IWSLT18 speech translation task, reproducing competitive baselines for fair comparison.
